text: Carpentry is the craft of constructing buildings, furniture, and other structures using wooden materials. The art form has been practiced for centuries, with early techniques relying heavily on simple tools and hand tools like chisels, hammers, and mallets. Nowadays, carpenters use power tools, including routers and jigs, to enhance precision and efficiency. Among the essential materials in carpentry is varnish, used to protect wood from moisture and wear, and to give surfaces a glossy or matte finish. Well-executed joints are the backbone of a strong and durable structure, with carpenters using techniques like mortise and tenon, peg and battens, and dovetail to create secure and aesthetically pleasing connections. As woodworking continues to evolve, so too does the understanding of joinery, ensuring that each piece is not only functional but also beautifully crafted.
